content: Migkaǥi pa is Nengazen te, “Pemineg kew, is menge etew te Israel, ragkes kew en is menge memumuhat wey menge sakup te pemilya te hadì, su heini he kedhukum ne para keniyu: Iring kew te penuǥes he nekeutel, su nezeetan tenged keniyu is menge etew ziyà te Mizpa wey Tabor.
Nekidsukulè kew kediey wey edtinguhè kew te kebpenhimatey, umbe ebmensuwen ku sikiyu is langun.
Netuenan ku is langun mehitenged keniyu te menge tig-Israel; wazà igkeeles niw kayi te kedì. Mid-azap kew te zuma he menge ed-ezapen, umbe neremerikan kew.

“Is mezaat he menge vaal niw iyan ed-eǥen keniyu wey kew kenà mekelikù kayi te kedì te Megbevayè niw. Su ziyà te gehinawa niw is mulin-ulin he edtukù keniyu te ked-azap te zuma he menge ed-ezapen, ne wazà a keniyu kilelaa he Nengazen.
Is kegkemepelevawen niw iyan ebpengintutuu he ereg kew he edsilutan. Ne tenged te menge salè niw ne egkezeetan kew is menge tig-Israel zuma te menge tig-Juda.
Edangep kew kayi te kedì pinaaǥi te kebpemuhat niw te menge kerehidu, kambing, wey vaka, piru kenè niw en egkeseǥazan is kebpekiduma ku keniyu su mid-iniyuǥan ku en sikiyu.
Siak is esawa niw, midluivan a keniyu te menge kevuwazan ni Israel, su ǥeina te kenà kediey is menge anak niw. Umbe ǥuntaan, edezeetan ku sikiyu wey is menge tanè niw seled dà te senge vulan.
Is Kebpetebekà te Juda wey Israel

“Ipezaǥing niw is menge vudyung wey menge trumpita su wey mekepengandam is menge etew ziyà te Gibea wey Rama! Ipezineg niw ziyà te Bet Aven is kulehian para te kebpekidtebek! Pengandam kew is menge etew te Benjamin!
Egkezeetan is Israel zutun te andew te kedsilut. Egkehitavù iyan is migkaǥi ku he ebpekesuǥat te menge tribu te Israel!
Is menge pengulu te Juda iring te menge etew he idhalin dan is menge simintu su mid-eǥawan dan te tanà is Israel. Umbe ibusbus ku ziyà te kandan is pauk ku he iring te zalem.
Edèdaaǥen is Israel wey midezeetan su ǥeina te midsilutan ku heini. Su mibpedayun heini medsunud te zuma he menge ed-ezapen.
Iring a te dezeizey he keranapranap he egketket te Israel wey Juda.
“Hein naahà te Israel wey Juda is kenà meupiya he kebpekesavuk dan, mibuyù te tavang is Israel ziyà te mekeǥeǥehem he hadì te Asiria. Piru kenà is Asiria ebpeketavang kandan.

Su edsurungen ku is Israel wey Juda he iring a te erimaung he ebpitaspitas te egkezawi zin. Iyan a mismu edezaat kandan. Ed-uwiten ku sikandan diyà te zuma he menge nasyun, ne wazà ebpekelibri kandan.
Ne kegkepasad dutun edlikù a ziyà te lugar ku, taman te ed-engkenen dan is menge salè dan. Ne edangep dan kayi te kedì tenged te kegkerasey zan.”
